player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''enhasa''') posted a [[Light]] list on DeckTech in September 2001.
description: This is a cool numbers/podracing/all out crazy high destiny deck that me and a couple of friends thought of last night.
cards: posted: Nar Shada Wind Chimes x5
posted: Never Tell me The Odds x7
posted: R2D2 in Red 5 x1 (or any other random destiny 7)
notes: No Objective. The strategy names Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber as the starting location and Podrace Prep as the starting interrupt (it deploys Boonta Eve Podrace, Anakin's Podracer and Tatooine: Podrace Arena); all are in the posted list and count toward the 60.
Never Tell Me The Odds and Anger, Fear, Aggression (the 'inserts') are Effects; they were posted under Interrupts (30).

Posted 'Surprise Assault' dested the Light Premiere interrupt Surprise Assault (the draft's Counter Surprise Assault is Dark); 'The Signal' dested the Light Jabba's Palace interrupt The Signal (the strategy uses it to get Bargaining Table).
Posted 'Chadra Fan' dested Chadra-Fan; 'Nar Shada Wind Chimes' Nar Shaddaa Wind Chimes; 'Annakin's Podracer' Anakin's Podracer; 'Do or Do Not' Do, Or Do Not; 'I Did It' I Did It!.
Posted 'R2D2 in Red 5 x1 (or any other random destiny 7)' dested Artoo-Detoo In Red 5 (Third Anthology, destiny 0 or 7).
